newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL gives 'AA' rating for Bharat NCD.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL gives 'AA' rating for Bharat NCD.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it has assigned an "AA" rating to the 300 million rupees Non Convertible Debenture Issue of Bharat Forge Ltd (BFL), indicating high safety regarding timely payment of interest and principal.
It said in a statement that BFL is engaged primarily in the manufacture of closed die forgings for the automobile industry and has its facilities located at Mundwha (Pune).

It also manufactures open die forgings and caters to the railway and defence markets and the engineering industry. Large automobile manufacturers such as TELCO and Ashok Leyland Ltd account for as much as 60 percent of the company's total sales.

BFL would be gradually increasing its forging, machined crankshafts and front axle beam assembly capacities over the next two to three years on account of the increased demand for its products and the market potential, CRISIL said.

BFL also has a financial services division undertaking money market, lease and hire purchase activities. Improving sales realisations due to a sharp increase in HCV and LCV demand in the last two years, contribution from the financial services division and reduced interest costs enabled the company to improve net profit margins from eight percent for 1994/95 to 11 percent for 1995/96. Interest coverage (PBDIT/Interest and finance charges) improved from 2.05 to 2.23 during the same period while gearing (Total Debt/Tangible Networth) reduced from 1.64 as at March 31, 1995 to 1.09 as at March 31, 1996, the statement said.
